schoolName: Anton de Kom University of Suriname — Faculty of Medical Sciences
reviewNotes: HOLD — AdeKUS officially lists Medicine, Physiotherapy and Public Health; 2025–26 medical admissions were Numerus Fixus with 30 medicine places. Its medicine course page explicitly says applicants must hold Surinamese nationality and reside in Suriname. The current public evidence does not support an international-study route, a current fee schedule, programme language, full clinical pathway, accommodation/support or current medicine-specific accreditation. This is a local-route medical programme, not a study-abroad lead candidate on current evidence.
